groups.name: iqkv.db
groups.description: Intermediary database connection properties. Values are composed into spring.datasource by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.rabbitmq
groups.description: Intermediary RabbitMQ connection properties. Values are composed into spring.rabbitmq by profile ymls.

groups.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq
groups.description: RabbitMQ messaging toggles. 'enabled' drives @ConditionalOnProperty in RabbitMQConfig.

groups.name: iqkv.platform
groups.description: Platform-wide operational settings. Must be consistent across all core services (IAM, Billing, CMS, etc.) — all read the same ROLLOUT_MODE env var. This service declares them in application.yml for consistency but has no local binding class.

groups.name: iqkv.tenancy
groups.description: Tenancy settings shared by the platform. This service declares them in application.yml for consistency but has no local binding class; tenant routing is handled by the foundation-tenancy library.

groups.name: iqkv.liquibase
groups.description: Tenant-aware Liquibase migration configuration. This service owns no changelogs — migrations are run by docintelligence-catalog-service — and Liquibase is not on the classpath, so the tenant runner never activates.

groups.name: iqkv.objectstorage
groups.description: S3-compatible object storage configuration. Shares the catalog-assets bucket with docintelligence-catalog-service; supports MinIO (SIT/UAT) and AWS S3 (production).

groups.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload
groups.description: Upload policy constraints applied before an object is sent to storage.

properties.name: iqkv.db.host
properties.description: Database server hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.db.port
properties.description: Database server port.

properties.name: iqkv.db.name
properties.description: Database name.

properties.name: iqkv.db.username
properties.description: Database username.

properties.name: iqkv.db.password
properties.description: Database password.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker hostname.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ broker AMQP port.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.username
properties.description: RabbitMQ username.

properties.name: iqkv.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: RabbitMQ password.

properties.name: iqkv.messaging.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Enables RabbitMQ messaging. When false, RabbitMQConfig is skipped. Defaults to false for local safety; the Helm chart configmap sets MESSAGING_ENABLED per environment (sit/uat/prd).

properties.name: iqkv.platform.rollout-mode
properties.description: Platform-wide operational mode. Must match across all core services. MULTI_TENANT: each signup creates a new tenant. SINGLE_TENANT: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-key
properties.description: NanoID key of the default tenant used in SINGLE_TENANT mode. Format: 8 characters using alphabet [a-z0-9].

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-tenant-name
properties.description: Display name for the default tenant in SINGLE_TENANT mode.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.schema-prefix
properties.description: PostgreSQL schema name prefix for tenant schemas resolved by MyBatisSchemaInterceptor.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.default-schema
properties.description: Default (system) schema name used when no tenant context is active.

properties.name: iqkv.tenancy.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for tenant schema provisioning.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-runner-enabled
properties.description: Registers the foundation-tenancy TenantLiquibaseRunner. Kept false here: this service runs no migrations and Liquibase is not on its classpath.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.system-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the system (public schema) Liquibase changelog. Inert here — declared to satisfy foundation-tenancy's @NotBlank binding and mirrored from docintelligence-catalog-service.

properties.name: iqkv.liquibase.tenant-change-log
properties.description: Classpath location of the per-tenant schema Liquibase changelog. Inert here — declared to satisfy foundation-tenancy's @NotBlank binding and mirrored from docintelligence-catalog-service.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.endpoint
properties.description: S3-compatible endpoint URL. Use the MinIO in-cluster service URL for SIT/UAT, or https://s3.amazonaws.com for AWS S3 in production.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.public-endpoint
properties.description: Publicly reachable object storage URL used to rewrite presigned URLs before returning them to external clients. When blank, presigned URLs are returned unchanged.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.access-key
properties.description: S3 / MinIO access key (username). Injected from a Kubernetes Secret in cluster environments.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.secret-key
properties.description: S3 / MinIO secret key (password). Injected from a Kubernetes Secret in cluster environments.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.bucket-name
properties.description: Name of the S3 bucket used to store catalog documents. Must match docintelligence-catalog-service — the bucket is shared.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.region
properties.description: AWS region identifier. Required by the S3 client even when connecting to MinIO.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.ssl
properties.description: Whether to use HTTPS when connecting to the object storage endpoint. Must be true in production.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.max-file-size-bytes
properties.description: Maximum allowed upload file size in bytes. Requests exceeding this limit are rejected before reaching storage.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.presigned-url-expiration-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of a pre-signed PUT or GET URL in minutes.

properties.name: iqkv.objectstorage.upload.allowed-mime-types
properties.description: Comma-separated list of accepted MIME types. Uploads with a Content-Type not in this list are rejected.

values.description: Multi-tenant mode: each signup creates a new tenant.
Single-tenant mode: all users join a single pre-provisioned tenant.
Enable RabbitMQ — used by local, sit, uat and prd profiles.
In-cluster MinIO endpoint (Docker Compose / local demo stack).
AWS S3 production endpoint (region resolver picks the bucket region).
Use HTTPS — required for production and AWS S3.
